tools.name: catalogo
tools.description: What can be ordered, at what price and under what name. Includes this MCP server's tools and the equivalent HTTP routes. Free.

tools.name: estado_fuentes
tools.description: Live probe of every public source behind the data (response, HTTP status and latency). Free: use it to decide whether a paid call is worth it, and to see where a number came from.

tools.name: precio
tools.description: What an asset is worth right now, in USD, as a MEDIAN across several venues with its spread - not a single exchange's last trade. Use it to quote, to compare venues or to spot a dislocated market. Cuesta $0.02 por llamada, en USDC sobre Base (protocolo x402).

symbols.description: Comma-separated symbols, up to 20. Example: BTC,ETH,SOL (por defecto: BTC)

tools.name: ficha_token
tools.description: What a token is and what it is worth: name, symbol, decimals, supply, contract address and price per token. Use it to confirm that an address is a real contract and what it represents. Cuesta $0.03 por llamada, en USDC sobre Base (protocolo x402).

tokens.description: Comma-separated contract addresses, up to 10. Example: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913

chain.description: Network the token lives on. (por defecto: base)

tools.name: velas
tools.description: Recent candles for a trading pair at the interval you ask for (1m to 1d). What you need to compute trend or volatility, or to draw a chart without an exchange API key. Cuesta $0.01 por llamada, en USDC sobre Base (protocolo x402).

limite.description: How many candles to return. (por defecto: 100)

tools.name: mercado
tools.description: The big picture: total market cap, Bitcoin dominance, 24 h change, the coins by market cap and the top movers. This is the context question, not the one about a single asset. Cuesta $0.03 por llamada, en USDC sobre Base (protocolo x402).

limite.description: How many coins to return in the market-cap list. (por defecto: 20)

tools.name: tvl_protocolo
tools.description: How much money is deposited in a DeFi protocol (TVL in USD) with its 24 h and 7 day change. The measure of a protocol's size and health before you interact with it. Cuesta $0.01 por llamada, en USDC sobre Base (protocolo x402).

protocol.description: DeFiLlama protocol identifier. Example: aave (por defecto: aave)

tools.name: saldo
tools.description: What an address holds: the native balance of the network and, if you pass a token, that ERC-20 balance with its decimals. Use it to verify a payment or a holding without opening a block explorer. Cuesta $0.03 por llamada, en USDC sobre Base (protocolo x402).

token.description: Optional: ERC-20 token contract (USDC on Base: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913).
